title: Starting a Tasmanian tenancy
description: The paperwork and steps before and when a Tasmanian tenant moves in. Summarised from Consumer Affairs Tasmania guidance and the Residential Tenancy Act 1997.

items.title: Check the property meets the minimum standards before you advertise
Check smoke alarms are hardwired or 10-year battery, in the right places and working
Prepare a written tenancy agreement (a fixed term must be at least 4 weeks)
Give the tenant the Tasmanian guide to renting
Give the tenant a copy of any strata rules they must follow
Give the tenant two signed copies of the Tasmanian residential tenancy condition report on or before move-in
Collect the tenant's signed copy within 2 days, with any notes
Ask for no more than 4 weeks' rent as bond, and no pet bond
Start the bond lodgement in Tasmanian MyBond and have the tenant pay the Rental Deposit Authority
Check the pool barrier and gate work
Give the tenant a copy of the signed agreement within 14 days
